import polars as pl

# Create a sample DataFrame with duplicate rows
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Alice", "Charlie", "Bob"],
    "age": [25, 30, 25, 35, 30],
    "city": ["NYC", "LA", "NYC", "Chicago", "LA"]
})

# Remove duplicate rows, keeping the first occurrence
df_unique = df.unique()
